‘Golmaal 5’ Release Date: Rohit Shetty Brings Back Nostalgia With Arshad Warsi And Sharman Joshi’s Viral Throwback Scene
‘Golmaal 5’ Release Date: Rohit Shetty Brings Back Nostalgia With Arshad Warsi And Sharman Joshi’s Viral Throwback Scene
'Golmaal 5’ is already creating excitement among fans as Rohit Shetty brings back the original gang and recreates iconic moments from the comedy franchise. Here’s everything to know about the expected release date, cast and latest shooting updates.
Rishika SinghMay 14, 2026, 16:48 IST

Golmaal 5 is officially in the works and Rohit Shetty is already making sure fans feel every bit of the nostalgia. The reunion of the original gang, now with a big new addition, has the internet more excited than it has been for a comedy film in a long time. From shooting in Ooty to recreating scenes from the 2006 original, the updates coming out of the Golmaal 5 set suggest this one is being made with a lot of love for the franchise.

'Golmaal 5' Release Date: When Is It Coming to Cinemas

Golmaal 5 is currently filming and is expected to release in 2027. No official date has been announced yet.

'Golmaal 5' Cast: Akshay Kumar Joins the Original Gang

The film reunites Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, Tusshar Kapoor, Shreyas Talpade and Kunal Kemmu, with Sharman Joshi returning to the franchise after nearly two decades. Akshay Kumar joins the cast for the first time and is reportedly playing the antagonist, which adds a fresh dynamic to the group.

Arshad Warsi and Sharman Joshi Recreate the Iconic Golmaal Car Race Scene

Rohit Shetty shared a video showing Arshad and Sharman waving from a race car, just as they did in the 2006 original. Sharman was dressed as a woman again, mirroring his character Laxman from the first film. Shetty captioned it, "Driving down the memory lane," and promised fans they would relive those moments very soon. The entire cast wrapped the Ooty schedule in late April, with Rohit Shetty sharing candid photos of the gang posing against the Nilgiri backdrop on a large bike.

​The Golmaal franchise began in 2006 and went on to deliver three more films over the next decade. Golmaal 5 marks the first time nearly the entire original ensemble is back together under Rohit Shetty's direction. Twenty years is a long time, and the fact that this cast is back together still feels like a genuine event. Golmaal 5 carries the weight of a franchise that defined a generation of Bollywood comedy. If the Ooty photos and that recreated scene are anything to go by, Rohit Shetty knows exactly what he is doing.​
